name: Roy's Wood Products
old_description: We provide a full line of wood products and the industry’s best hardware and accessories: from custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts to dovetail drawer boxes, face frame material, hardwood plywood and mouldings, dimensional lumber, shutters, & more.
about:
Roy's Wood Products operates from Lugoff, South Carolina, where Roy Brazell Sr. founded the business in 1962 as a garage shop producing cabinet doors. The company remains family-owned, passing to his son Roy Brazell Jr. in 1985, who expanded the operation to 15,000 square feet. In 2000 the name changed to Roy's Wood Products, Inc., and in 2008 grandsons Jody and Russell Brazell acquired the business, continuing three generations of family leadership.

The firm manufactures a full line of wood components including custom cabinet doors, drawer fronts, dovetail drawer boxes, face frames, hardwood plywood, mouldings, dimensional lumber, and shutters, alongside a range of hardware and accessories. Production takes place in a facility exceeding 61,000 square feet that houses a rough mill and a dedicated cabinet door manufacturing plant, supported by experienced craftsmen and modern equipment.

Its customers span cabinet shops, millwork operations, and building professionals who source both stock and custom wood products for residential and commercial projects. The company supplies both standard and made-to-order items to meet varied project requirements.

The company emphasizes an old-fashioned focus on excellence at a reasonable price, a principle carried through three generations of the Brazell family and reflected in its commitment to quality products and dependable service.
